report.summary: The only change makes /opt/tempo/pi/tempo-profile.ts root-owned with mode 0600. The image runs as user tempo (uid 1000), and tempod starts pi as tempo with `-e /opt/tempo/pi/tempo-profile.ts`, so pi cannot read the Tempo extension. That breaks MCP server registration and the tools.allow/deny guard the spec relies on to enforce limits, and it fails the existing image test that checks the file is readable as uid 1000. Do not merge.

findings.text: The Pi extension is copied root-owned with mode 0600, so the runtime user tempo cannot read it. Pi fails to load the extension that registers per-agent MCP servers and enforces tools.allow/deny (including read-only write/edit denial).

evidence.why: COPY has no --chown, so the file is root:root. Line 40 only runs `chmod 0755 /opt/tempo /opt/tempo/pi` on the folders, and the image ends with `USER tempo`. Spec 01 says pi is started with `-e /opt/tempo/pi/tempo-profile.ts` and that the extension's tool_call guard "is what enforces the limits". As uid 1000, opening this file gets a permission error, so pi either fails to start or runs without the guard. packages/tempod/test/image.test.ts:30 asserts `accessSync("/opt/tempo/pi/tempo-profile.ts", constants.R_OK)` does not throw, and that check would now fail. The file is checked-in code with no secret, so 0600 gains nothing. There is no spec or IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES change either.

checked.risk: Build and runtime environment: file mode and owner of the copied extension against the user that runs pi
Tests: does the existing image test cover readability of the extension
Spec: is the mode change backed by the spec or IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES
Security: does the file hold anything that needs restricting (it is checked-in source with no secret)

args.command: git rev-parse HEAD && cat -n container/Dockerfile && grep -rn "tempo-profile" --exclude-dir=node_modules . | head -30
args.description: Show Dockerfile and references to the profile file

args.command: sed -n 20,40p packages/tempod/test/image.test.ts; grep -n "0644\|/opt/tempo\|read-only\|runs as" "docs/01 Runtime and Agents.md" | head -20
args.description: Read image test and spec file-mode lines

args.command: grep -n "chmod\|tempo-profile" "docs/01 Runtime and Agents.md" | head; grep -rn "tempo-profile\|0644\|0600" docs/IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md | head
args.description: Check spec for the COPY mode
